verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of user-defined event rules is Cost Management budgets, where you configure alerts that fire on actual or forecasted spend thresholds. That is a narrow rule-to-notification mechanism, not general event-driven automation. Missing for 10: general event-routing or rule-engine documentation (e.g., event subscriptions or workflow triggers), rules that trigger arbitrary actions rather than just alerts, coverage beyond cost events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
